query: SELECT t.source_id,t.upstream_name,t.path FROM tools t JOIN sources s ON s.id=t.source_id JOIN endpoints e ON e.id=$1 WHERE (e.all_sources OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_sources es WHERE es.endpoint_id=e.id AND es.source_id=t.source_id)) AND ($2::text[] IS NULL OR t.path=ANY($2)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest($3::text[]) terms(pattern) WHERE NOT(t.path ILIKE pattern OR t.description ILIKE pattern)) ORDER BY t.path FOR SHARE OF s
